note: Inyo NF campground in red fir and Jeffrey pine between June Mountain and Obsidian Dome, reached from US-395 by Obsidian Dome Road and FR 2S48. Sites are on the small forested side; no length is posted, but mid-size RVs use the gravel spurs. --Claude
